# ui-week-grid — Design

## API used (read from `api/routers/*`, types generated by `npm run gen:api`)
| Call | Use |
|---|---|
| `GET /clinics` | clinic picker (from `data/manual/clinic_stops.csv`) — **new, additive** |
| `GET /audit?clinic&community=all&day` | one call per day → grid rows, equity, sources |
| `GET /audit/blockgroups?clinic&day[&hour]` | map points (lat/lon, share, desert) — **new, additive** |
| `POST /whatif {clinic, shift:{block:"mon-08", to}}` | move preview; same shape as `/audit` |
| schedule suggestion | **no endpoint yet** → typed stub `suggestSchedule()` returns `{status:"unavailable"}` |

The two new endpoints are additive (no existing shape changed); `engine/audit.py` stays the
one aggregation path. Announce them to the team with the contracts update.

## Definitions
- **Cell share** = `cell.share` from `/audit` (already in [0, 1]); shown as `Math.round(share*100)%`.
- **Day share** = mean of that day's cell shares (each block weighted equally).
- **Move delta** = `dayShare(whatif.cells) − dayShare(audit[day].cells)`.
- **Last block home** = latest hour with share > 0 (nobody gets home from later blocks).

## Modules
```
web/src/
  api/client.ts      typed fetch wrapper (base /api), errors as ApiError
  api/schema.d.ts    generated from FastAPI OpenAPI
  lib/metrics.ts     pure: clampShare, formatPct, dayShare, moveDelta, lastBlockHome, binFor
  hooks/useAsync.ts  {status: loading|error|empty|ready}
  components/        Map, WeekGrid, DayRibbon, ProvenanceChip, SuggestPanel, EquityPanel, AsyncState
  pages/AuditPage.tsx
  i18n/{en,es}.json, i18n/index.ts
  styles/tokens.css  light + dark tokens
```

## Move interaction
`WeekGrid` owns a `pending` state `{day, from, to}`. Drag: `dragstart` sets `from`, `drop` on a
cell in the same row calls `onMove(day, from, to)` once and clears the drag state (a guard
ref blocks a second call from the same gesture). Keyboard: roving tabindex; Enter on a cell
picks it up, ← → move the target, Enter calls `onMove` once, Esc cancels. `from === to` is a
no-op. `AuditPage.onMove` posts `/whatif` and shows before → after in an `aria-live` region.

## Map
MapLibre with an empty local style (background only, no tiles) and one GeoJSON circle layer.
Fill colour = `--scale-N` bin of share (`d3-scale` `scaleQuantize`, 5 bins); deserts get a thick
dark stroke. Legend lists each bin with its numeric range plus the desert outline. A text
summary sits beside the map. Tests mock `maplibre-gl` (no WebGL in jsdom).

## Testing
- Vitest + fast-check properties (see tasks 8–12).
- Playwright e2e with API routes intercepted by fixtures (deterministic, no backend needed).
- `@axe-core/playwright` scan of the Audit screen; fails on serious/critical violations.
